name: Pattern-to-Pattern Variable Holding Period
note: Enter on a white marubozu (closing or opening variant, the Goo-Chen-Chang one-day inequalities with equality tolerance eps = eps_frac * bar range) while price is above its EMA(10); hold with no target, no time stop and no ordinary stop, and exit only when the opposing black marubozu set prints. mode 0 goes flat on that signal, mode 1 reverses and stays always-in. The only price-based protection is the 4 x ATR catastrophic guard the paper specifies, carried as st_atr.
source: Lu, Shiu & Liu (2012), variable-holding-period ('LSL') exit strategy - buy on a bullish signal, liquidate when a bearish pattern occurs - described and contrasted against the MYR and CL exits in Tharavanij, Siraprapasiri & Rajchamaha (2017), SAGE Open, doi:10.1177/2158244017736799. One-day pattern inequalities from Goo, Chen & Chang (2007), reproduced in the same paper.
